task: Make English-only-artifacts a mechanical fact via two layers: a warn-only PreToolUse(Bash) hook and a diff/story-scoped CJK gate in lattice validate
outcome: When an agent runs a git commit or lattice story-metadata command containing Chinese, the terminal immediately prints a warning like: warn english-only: CJK detected in artifact; Lattice artifacts must be English (the command still proceeds). When the current story commit messages or author-controlled metadata contain CJK, lattice validate prints an English failure line naming the file/commit and exits non-zero, blocking REVIEW to TEST; on English-only artifacts validate stays green and the gate passes.
facts: .claude/settings.json and .claude/hooks/*.cjs are framework-generated managed assets (worktree CLAUDE.md Claude Prompt Hook section); the generation source is init-assets.ts plus managed-assets.ts, and these must be edited rather than the artifacts
init-assets.ts getClaudeHooks() (~line 438) defines the settings.json hook map; hookCommand() builds the node command; hook .cjs script contents are embedded in init-assets.ts
managed-assets.ts kind claude-settings plus mergeClaudeHooks keep .claude/settings.json synced for lattice check --apply
the existing PreToolUse hook matches Edit/Write/MultiEdit/NotebookEdit; git commit and lattice commands run via Bash, so a new PreToolUse matcher Bash entry is needed
lattice validate --lint is a REVIEW to TEST preflight CLI gate; the new CJK gate should be a sibling preflight check wired into the same runner
pretool-scope-hook-smoke.ts and host-guard-matrix-smoke.ts cover hook generation and may need updates
constraints: All new code, comments, commit messages, and story metadata must be English-only (dogfood the policy)
Detection is diff/story-scoped only; never scan the whole repo or legacy files
Layer 1 hook is warn-only (exit 0); layer 2 validate gate is a hard non-zero fail
The hook must be self-contained (no dependency on dist) with its CJK range kept in sync with the core detector via a test
Do not hand-edit generated .claude assets; edit the generation source and let init/check produce them
Coverage is commits plus lattice story author-controlled metadata only
